title: NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover just shattered the all-time off-world driving record
caption:
NASA's Perseverance rover has officially logged over 28 miles across Mars, setting an all-time distance record on another world in just over five years. Onboard autonomous navigation allowed it to map hazards in real time, dramatically outpacing earlier missions.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover just shattered the all-time off-world driving record
